name: agent-skills
description: Portable Agent Skills for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node scripts/continuous-improvement.mjs validate-policy && node scripts/validate-evaluations.mjs
scripts.routing:smoke: node scripts/run-routing-evaluations.mjs --suite evals/routing.json --adapter node --adapter-arg tests/fixtures/routing-adapter.mjs --out tmp/evaluations/routing.json
scripts.runtime:smoke: node scripts/run-runtime-smoke.mjs --suite tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/suite.json --adapter claude-code=@node --adapter-entrypoint claude-code=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --adapter-arg claude-code=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --adapter github-copilot=@node --adapter-entrypoint github-copilot=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --adapter-arg github-copilot=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --adapter openai-codex=@node --adapter-entrypoint openai-codex=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --adapter-arg openai-codex=tests/fixtures/runtime-smoke/adapter.mjs --out tmp/runtime-smoke/public-result.json

author: Cody Sims
